title: Quench remaining VM and host work
constraints: Rust implementation and Rust-generated copy-and-patch stencils; OXC owns syntax.
Apple M4/macOS is the required performance target; preserve existing platform behavior.
Measure complete V8-v7 at meaningful milestones after affected-path correctness and safety checks.
No arbitrary architectural or source-size ceilings; resource policies require explicit purpose and safe exhaustion.
Task state lives here; completed task content is removed, with committed history in Git.

evidence.goal: Establish reproducible comparisons before performance claims.
